Card C08106-K1 has three prior confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3778, CC-2121, CC-1736) from August and September 2016, all involving card-not-present fraud after cardholder dispute reports.
Holder C08106-K1|NA|180 had zero prior transactions before 2016-12-29 and has no recurring billing pattern to authenticate transaction 3583227 as legitimate recurring activity.
Card C08106-K1 belongs to Louvain community 139460792 with a fraud rate of 1.0 (lift of 9.9 vs base rate) alongside card C13447-K1.
The bank's second-generation calibrated fraud model scored transaction 3583227 at 0.005 with an empirical fraud rate of 0.006 (0.6%), and legacy risk score was 0.34.
Device D001477 has a generic profile (unknown | unknown | firefox 47.0 | unknown), zero closed fraud cases all-time across 6 cards, and was used by only card C08106-K1 in the 30-day window.
Transaction 3583227 was an isolated online purchase with no preceding card-testing authorizations observed in the card activity window.

evidence.claim: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and your assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend `VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER` or `STEP_UP_AUTH` before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

case.summary: Cardholder C08106 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $128.33 (transaction 3583227) on card C08106-K1 on December 29, 2016. The charge was conducted via a new device (D001477) with no prior holder history to indicate legitimate recurring activity. Card C08106-K1 also carries three prior confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3778, CC-2121, and CC-1736) from previous card-not-present compromises. Given the direct cardholder denial and absence of positive exculpatory evidence, the activity was determined to be card-not-present fraud and card C08106-K1 was blocked.
